McNair Professor of Marketing Malcolm P. McNair Professor of Marketing Read more Elie Ofek is the Malcolm P. McNair of Professor Business Administration in the Marketing unit at Harvard Business School. His research explores firms' innovation strategies and pricing approaches to capture value, particularly in technology-driven markets. He further examines the business implications of AI and how evolving consumer trends shape go-to-market and brand management.
